from __future__ import annotations
import importlib.util
import json
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))

from control.model_execution.direct_sol_chat import validate_request

runner_path=ROOT/"control/jobs/full_a2z_governed_v4.py"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("a2z_runner_preflight",runner_path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

bundle=ROOT/"control/dev_checks/direct_sol_runner_preflight_bundle"
if bundle.exists():
    shutil.rmtree(bundle)
bundle.mkdir(parents=True)

binding="a"*64
mod.direct_sol_request(
    bundle,
    {"candidate_id":mod.CID},
    "SOL_BUILD",
    "A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-DIRECT-PREFLIGHT",
    "Synthetic routing-only prompt; do not execute experiment code.",
    binding,
)
p=bundle/"direct_requests/A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-DIRECT-PREFLIGHT.json"
obj=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
validate_request(obj)
assert obj["schema"]=="PREDICTION_DIRECT_SOL_REQUEST_V1"
assert obj["phase"]=="SOL_BUILD"
assert obj["target_model"]=="gpt-5.6-sol"
assert obj["target_experience"]=="CHAT"
assert obj["execution_layer"]=="DIRECT_SOL_CHAT"
assert obj["binding_sha256"]==binding
assert obj["candidate_id"]==mod.CID
assert obj["campaign_id"]==mod.CAMPAIGN
assert obj["live_trading"] is False
assert obj["paid_actions"] is False
assert obj["wallet_actions"] is False

src=runner_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert 'direct_sol_request(repo, overlay, "SOL_BUILD"' in src
assert 'prepare_review(repo, overlay, "POSTBUILD"' in src
assert '"ASTRA_" + phase' in src

print("DIRECT_SOL_ROUTING_PREFLIGHT=PASS")
print("DIRECT_SOL_INPUT_SHA256="+obj["input_sha256"])
print("DIRECT_SOL_BINDING_SHA256="+obj["binding_sha256"])
